Name: Field Harvest
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
To harvest an entire field of crops with this mod, hold down the modifier key (default: [b]Left Shift[/b]) and harvest one of the crops in the field.

By default, only crops from the same seed as the original tile are harvested. You can edit the mod's config.json to harvest all connected dirt tiles instead.

By default, crops harvested drop in place. You can edit the mod's config.json to have them auto-added to inventory instead.

By default, diagonal-only joined tiles are not considered part of the same field. You can switch this in the mod's config.json file.


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], uses Harmony.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.
